name: Visual Grounding Safety
summary: Compares refusal between free-text and grounding outputs (points or bounding boxes) on matched harmful requests, and proposes a fine-tuning approach for the grounding channel.
numbers: 15,401 pairs, 5 VLMs; grounding refusal 31–59 points below text refusal; fine-tuning closes most of it

why.cog: Refuse a harmful request in a structured output channel.
why.xr: Reuses ASIMOV 2.0 and general harm sets; shows the action-facing channel is less aligned.
